verdict.rationale: Docs show memory is naturally scoped per stateful agent (each agent has its own persistent memory/MemFS) and that cross-agent sharing is only via explicit opt-in 'shared-memory' Git repos, implying isolation by default; self-hosting also lets you isolate infrastructure per tenant. However, there is no explicit documentation of per-user or per-application tenancy controls, access-control enforcement, or guarantees preventing retrieval leakage across tenants sharing an agent/app. Missing for 10: explicit multi-tenant/user-scoping API or policy docs, access-control enforcement details, and any independent verification that isolation holds under multi-tenant use.
